title: MySQL Error 1064: SQL Syntax Error on Import
description: The parser rejects a statement — usually a bad split, a version mismatch, or a truncated file rather than a real syntax problem.
causes: File split mid-statement by a non-SQL-aware tool
MySQL 8 syntax imported into MariaDB or MySQL 5.7
fixes: Split at statement boundaries so chunks stay valid
Match the export and import server versions
Check the dump ends with a clean 'Dump completed' marker
